author: vulpec
body: Your biggest asset will be to use the community discord. Not only will members help you answer any questions, but because the game updates constantly with somewhat vague patch notes, discord can be the most direct way to learn of recent changes or meta-shortcuts. For example, you'll see screenshots of the newest raid gear drops, learn the current meta for levelling up (be it the DV2 spam of the past or the current venin-baha-tamer/swashy), know how adornments work without doing the experiment yourself, or find out that panacea doesn't drop from Apo anymore.  The community is quite strong, use it.

author: DerBoyOrna
body:
I cannot recommend the ring of restraint if you want to play in the direction of endgame. it will only hold you back. the exp curve is very stiff. 
its kind of a noobie trap.
if you really enjoy the pvp aspect of the game, then it might be worth it, but i digret. 
on the contrary, i would say always use silver and gold coins along side exp potions and affinity candles. at a certain lvl you will drain in them pots. so dont be afraid to use those since they will increase your development significantly

i am 217 titanguard currently, and i have about 1000 of each left.

author: asianjew620
body:
I went from new player to into the top 400 in 75 days.

Decide if you're going to be a casual or press with the top dogs. Surround yourself with players with the same mentality, but remember it is a GAME.

Find a kingdom that fits your mindset and attitude.

Get a ring of restraint ASAP. This is very important if you are grinding hard, even without boss runs/explores.

Dont do gauntlets unless you've got your coins and shrines. 

And that's about it from my neck of the woods.

Good luck, and welcome!
